items.title: Tim Cook’s Tough Act to Follow at Apple
items.summary: Since Tim Cook took over as Apple's CEO in 2011, the iPhone maker's stock has soared more than 2,200%. Annualized, that gives investors a price move of about 23.5% a year, more than twice the annual gain of the Dow industrials and easily more than the S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite.

items.title: Apple vet Schiller steps down from App Store and product event roles - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apple Inc. veteran executive Phil Schiller has relinquished oversight of the App Store and product launch events, marking a major executive transition just as the iPhone maker prepares for a historic leadership shift. According to a Bloomberg report, the 66-year-old executive will remain at the company under his Apple Fellow title to focus on unspecified initiatives. The departure from operational duties comes immediately ahead of John Ternus assuming the role of Chief Executive
